categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Hengshuai Co., Ltd. primarily operates in automotive micro-motor manufacturing and fluid technology products, including automotive motors, cleaning pumps, cleaning systems, and thermal management systems. The company organizes its business into four main units: motor business, electric module business, driving vision cleaning systems, and thermal management systems. It serves both traditional fuel vehicles and new energy vehicles, with a focus on automotive applications and expanding into industrial automation and humanoid robots.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced motor technologies such as harmonic magnetic field motors and new magnetic materials, which offer high power density, compact size, and cost efficiency. It employs platform-based, standardized product strategies and has developed intelligent, fully automated production lines integrating sensors, robotic arms, and vision systems. The production follows 'make-to-order' and 'sales-driven production' models, with ERP systems managing orders, inventory, and logistics. The company also pursues vertical integration by producing key components like motor housings and plastic injection parts internally.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global and domestic automotive manufacturers such as BMW, Honda, Hyundai, BYD, Geely, and Great Wall, as well as tier-1 and tier-2 automotive parts suppliers like Bosch and Continental. The company serves the automotive OEM market predominantly, with a smaller portion of sales to aftermarket and other distribution channels. It also targets emerging markets in advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), autonomous driving, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant domestic sales and production facilities. It has expanded its global footprint with wholly-owned subsidiaries and production bases in the United States, Thailand, and Singapore to better serve overseas customers and mitigate supply chain risks. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 39.2% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Hengshuai is positioned upstream in the automotive supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of critical automotive micro-motors and fluid system components. It supplies directly to OEMs and tier-1 suppliers, engaging in synchronous development with vehicle manufacturers. The company also integrates upstream by producing core components and materials, such as magnetic materials, to enhance control over quality and costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes independent innovation with a focus on harmonic magnetic field motor technology and new magnetic materials. It invests in R&D for advanced cleaning systems for ADAS sensors, thermal management components for new energy vehicles, and electric modules to increase product value. Future R&D priorities include expanding motor applications to vehicle interiors and chassis, industrial automation, and humanoid robots. The company also plans to enhance intelligent manufacturing capabilities and deepen global market integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive micro-motors, cleaning pumps, cleaning systems, and thermal management products to OEMs and automotive parts suppliers. The company uses a direct sales model for OEMs and tier-1 suppliers, and a buyout sales model for aftermarket and trade customers. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control, typically at product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global leaders in automotive micro-motors such as Asmo (Denso), NIDEC, Bosch, and Mabuchi Motors. Among domestic competitors, Dechang Motor is noted. Ningbo Hengshuai positions itself as a technology-driven, quality-focused supplier with strong customer relationships and a growing presence in emerging segments like ADAS cleaning systems and new energy vehicle components. It aims to leverage vertical integration and automation to maintain cost and quality advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 962 million, a 4.21% increase over 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 214 million, up 5.75%. Total assets reached RMB 1.58 billion, growing 11.08% year-over-year. The company maintains a healthy cash flow and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting steady growth and scale in the automotive parts manufacturing sector.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Hengshuai emphasizes high reliability, advanced technology, and integrated system solutions tailored to automotive OEM requirements. Its harmonic magnetic field motor technology and proprietary magnetic materials provide superior power density, compactness, and cost efficiency. The company’s platform-based product design and intelligent automated manufacturing ensure consistent quality and competitive pricing. Its close collaboration with leading OEMs and tier-1 suppliers enables synchronized development, enhancing product fit and performance in emerging automotive applications such as ADAS and new energy vehicles.
